identification_key: Lobby portraits carry no names. Each cookie is named from its element icon and art, checked against the author's text and the round brief, using the key in r2026-10-09 dc-2/dc-3. Light (sun icon): 브시커 = brown hair, purple eye, pink hat, crossbow icon. 치케 = gold curly hair, blue frame. 우유 = white nurse with the purple leader banner and pink bear. 실론 = white-bearded knight, shield icon. 팝콘 = star-spangled red/white/blue glasses; confirmed by 84830-2, a sugar-rune screen titled '팝콘맛 쿠키', and by the titles of 84830 and 84918. 딸크 = pink fluffy hair, shield icon (84918, whose text says 팝콘딸크; 85259, whose ATK order ends in 딸). Water (drop): 피겨 = gold face, purple headphones, bell icon. 메소 = green hair, white goggles, crossbow. Grass (leaf): 샤르도네 = pale lilac/pink hair with a green streak, double-chevron icon. 정전 = teal hair, orange flower, bell icon. 마카롱 = pink hair under a red/white hat (84663-3 only). Dark (moon): 석류 = red curly hair, double chevron. 피노 = grey hair, monocle. 닼초 = black/red hair, shield icon. Fire (flame): 전갈 = red hair, crossbow. 체리 = round orange face with red/white, blue frame, Lv.80 (84663-3 only; identified by elimination from the author's 'Macaron-Cherry deck'). Stars: each card shows five star slots. Gold only = 1–5★; each pink star replaces a gold one, so 4 pink + 1 gold = 9★ and 5 pink = 10★. 84663-3 and 84663-5 are sharp 850px crops and are read with confidence. The other lobbies are full-screen captures where a star is about 12px, so their stars carry a '?' and the visible impression; '?' alone means unreadable. Images were read at native size with no crops. Pets: bun with sauce = 핫도그, green cactus-like = 와사비문어, white round with red/green trim = 색동주머니; the number on each pet tile is transcribed as shown. Every lobby in the batch shows the boss with a moon (Dark) icon and '약점' (weakness) with a sun (Light) icon.

Plates, gear preset, pets, sugar runes, research and breakthrough were held equal; only Macaron/Cherry was swapped for Chardonnay/Melon Soda, with levels re-tuned. Macaron-Cherry at 4.27G: mean 423배, range 201–711배, max 3.036T. Chardonnay at 4.40G: mean 809배, range 592–1024배, max 4.504T. The spread narrows from more than 3x to under 2x. Both lineups run Pomegranate at Lv.1, and the author says her ATK rank doesn't matter because she gives the buff rather than receiving it.

posts.title_en: How far above the average does a Conquest high-roll go?
posts.summary_en: Over 50 runs the author averages about 3.2T, and no run fell outside 2.7–3.7T (about ±20%). 언담 replies that with Macaron gone the high/low gap is small. The swing now comes down to whether Pomegranate receives Tiger Lily, and you can spot a high-roll from Cheesecake's or Tea Knight's skill amp. The image is a sticker.
rng: 50 runs: spread about ±20% of the mean (2.7–3.7T around 3.2T)
Main random factor after Macaron left: whether Pomegranate receives Tiger Lily
A high-roll can be read from Cheesecake's or Tea Knight's skill amp

quotes.kr: 50판돌렸는데 고점 저점차이가 평균에서 플마20퍼 정도인거 같은데 2배 이상 나오는거지? 지금 평균 3.2T 정도인데 2.7-3.7 바깥으로 간판이 한판도 안나옴
